summary: Charleston’s Clay Center roof and planetarium dome were reconstructed from two airborne laser flight lines. Both photographs below were withheld from the surface-color and camera-registration fits.
measurement: At the same fixed Godot camera pose, the left-side skyline error fell from 43.5 to 24.9 pixels in frame 2860 and from 52.8 to 19.6 in frame 2861. Each test uses 254 columns in a 640 × 480 image. The new roof still rises above parts of the photographed skyline. These measurements are separate from the original full-view Charleston result.
